stem: Employees complained that the new dress code seemed entirely ____ , since no one could explain why certain colours were banned while others were allowed.
explain_zh: arbitrary 表示「（決定或規則）隨意的、無合理依據的」；justified（合理的）、logical（合乎邏輯的）、standard（標準的）都與「沒人能解釋規則背後的原因」矛盾。雅思寫作 Task 2 常用 arbitrary 批評缺乏合理依據的政策或規則。

stem: Limited public funding continues to ____ the number of research projects that universities are able to carry out each year.
explain_zh: constrain 表示「限制、約束」（因資源不足而限制某事的規模）；expand（擴大）語意相反，publicise（公開宣傳）、evaluate（評估）都不符合「經費有限而限制研究計畫數量」。雅思閱讀學術資源議題文章常用 constrain 描述資源不足帶來的限制。

stem: The witness's second statement appeared to directly ____ what she had originally told police officers at the scene of the accident.
explain_zh: contradict 表示「（前後說法）互相矛盾」；support（支持）、confirm（證實）語意相反，repeat（重複）也不符合「兩次說法明顯不一致」。雅思閱讀常用 contradict 描述證詞或數據前後矛盾。

stem: Several long-term studies suggest that hours of sleep ____ strongly with academic performance among secondary school students across several countries.
explain_zh: correlate (with) 表示「有相關性」；differ（不同）、compete（競爭）、interfere（干擾）都無法表達「兩個變項之間存在統計上的相關性」。雅思閱讀統計研究文章常用 correlate with 描述兩項數據之間的關聯。

stem: Although each individual change seemed minor, the ____ effect of the reforms transformed the entire education system within a decade.
explain_zh: cumulative 表示「累積的」（多個小變化累積起來產生的總效果）；isolated（孤立的）、temporary（暫時的）、immediate（立即的）都與「個別改變雖小，累積效果卻巨大」不符。雅思閱讀常用 cumulative effect 描述長期累積造成的總體影響。

stem: Auditors were asked to investigate the ____ between the company's reported profits and the figures found in its bank records.
explain_zh: discrepancy 表示（兩項數字或說法之間的）「差異、不一致」；balance（平衡）、agreement（一致）語意相反，total（總計）也不符合「帳目與銀行紀錄對不上」的情境。雅思閱讀財務稽核文章常用 discrepancy 描述資料之間對不上的落差。

stem: Public trust in the institution began to ____ rapidly after several senior officials were found to have accepted bribes.
explain_zh: diminish 表示「減少、削弱」；increase（增加）、strengthen（增強）語意相反，spread（擴散）也不符合「信任度因貪污醜聞而下降」。雅思閱讀政治與信任議題文章常用 diminish 描述信任或影響力的下降。

stem: Open-ended interview questions are more likely to ____ detailed, honest responses than questions that simply require a yes or no answer.
explain_zh: elicit 表示「引出、誘出」（反應或資訊）；prevent（阻止）、ignore（忽略）、suppress（壓抑）都與「開放式問題更能引出詳細誠實的回答」矛盾。雅思閱讀研究方法文章常用 elicit responses/information 描述如何引出受訪者的真實想法。

stem: The new headquarters was designed to ____ the company's core values of transparency, sustainability and innovation in every architectural detail.
explain_zh: embody 表示「體現、具體展現」（抽象的理念）；ignore（忽略）、contradict（牴觸）、hide（隱藏）都與「建築細節具體展現公司核心價值」矛盾。雅思閱讀建築與企業文化文章常用 embody 描述具體事物如何展現抽象理念。

stem: Regular group discussions have been shown to ____ students' understanding of difficult concepts far more effectively than silent individual study.
explain_zh: enhance 表示「提升、增進」；limit（限制）、confuse（使困惑）語意都相反或不符，replace（取代）也不符合「小組討論能更有效提升學生理解」。雅思寫作 Task 2 常用 enhance 描述某方法能提升學習或工作成效。

stem: Becoming a licensed pilot ____ hundreds of hours of flight training as well as passing several rigorous written examinations.
explain_zh: entail 表示「牽涉、需要」（某過程必然包含的要求）；avoid（避免）、shorten（縮短）、replace（取代）都無法表達「成為合格飛行員必然需要的條件」。雅思閱讀職業訓練類文章常用 entail 描述某資格所需具備的條件。

stem: It would be misleading to ____ a country's economic growth with genuine improvements in ordinary citizens' quality of life.
explain_zh: equate…with 表示「將…等同於」；separate（分開）、distinguish（區分）、contrast（對比）語意都與「錯誤地把經濟成長等同於生活品質改善」相反。雅思寫作 Task 2 常用 it is misleading to equate A with B 提醒讀者不要混淆兩個概念。

stem: Decades of coastal development have gradually begun to ____ the natural sand dunes that once protected the town from storms.
explain_zh: erode 表示「侵蝕、逐漸破壞」；strengthen（強化）、expand（擴大）、restore（恢復）都與「沿海開發逐漸侵蝕沙丘」矛盾。雅思閱讀環境類文章常用 erode 描述海岸線或土壤逐漸被侵蝕的現象。

stem: Over the course of a single century, the city's transport system has ____ from horse-drawn carts into a fully automated underground network.
explain_zh: evolve 表示（隨時間）「演變、逐漸發展」；collapsed（崩潰）、paused（暫停）、reversed（逆轉）都與「歷經一世紀逐漸發展成現代系統」不符。雅思閱讀科技與都市發展文章常用 evolve 描述系統隨時間演變。

stem: Multinational corporations can ____ considerable influence over government policy, particularly in countries that depend heavily on foreign investment.
explain_zh: exert influence 表示「施加影響力」；lose（失去）、avoid（避免）、resist（抵抗）都與「跨國企業對政府政策施加相當大的影響力」不符。雅思寫作 Task 2 常用 exert influence/pressure 描述某群體施展影響力。

stem: Environmentalists remind policymakers that fossil fuels are a ____ resource that will eventually run out if consumption continues at the current rate.
explain_zh: finite 表示「有限的」（數量有限，終將耗盡）；renewable（可再生的）、unlimited（無限的）、abundant（豐富的）都與「終將耗盡」的警告矛盾。雅思閱讀環境資源議題文章常用 finite resources 描述有限而終將枯竭的資源。

stem: This year's sharp rise in graduate unemployment ____ a similar pattern recorded during the previous global financial crisis.
explain_zh: echo 表示「（現象）重演、與過去相似」；prevents（阻止）、denies（否認）、reverses（逆轉）都無法表達「今年的失業率上升與過去金融危機時的模式相似」。雅思寫作 Task 1 常用 echo 描述目前的數據走勢與過去某個時期相似。

stem: Inflation has ____ around three percent for the past two years, neither rising sharply nor falling back to the bank's target level.
explain_zh: hover (around) 表示「（數值）徘徊在某個範圍附近」；surged（激增）、collapsed（崩跌）、doubled（翻倍）都與「維持在某個數值附近，沒有明顯升降」不符。雅思寫作 Task 1 常用 hover around 描述數據長期維持在某個範圍內波動不大。

stem: Currency exchange rates can ____ wildly within a single trading day, making it risky for small businesses to plan international purchases in advance.
explain_zh: oscillate 表示「（數值）在兩個極端之間來回波動」；stabilise（穩定下來）、average（取平均）、plateau（持平）都與「單日內劇烈來回波動」矛盾。雅思寫作 Task 1 常用 oscillate 描述數據在短時間內劇烈上下波動。

stem: After climbing steeply for several years, the graph shows the number of new subscribers beginning to ____ as the market becomes saturated.
explain_zh: flatten out 表示（原本上升或下降的曲線）「趨於平緩」；accelerate（加速）、collapse（崩跌）、reverse（逆轉）都與「成長曲線逐漸變得平緩」不符。雅思寫作 Task 1 常用 flatten out 描述原本陡峭的趨勢線變得平緩。

stem: Enthusiasm for the fitness app tends to ____ after the first few months, as shown by the sharp drop in daily active users.
explain_zh: tail off 表示「逐漸減少、逐漸消退」；intensify（加劇）、resume（恢復）、rebound（反彈）都與「使用者熱度逐漸下降」矛盾。雅思寫作 Task 1 常用 tail off 描述數據緩慢下滑至低點。

stem: Demand for winter coats begins to ____ once temperatures start rising in early spring, giving retailers time to plan seasonal discounts.
explain_zh: ease off 表示（強度或速度）「逐漸減緩」；intensify（加劇）、accelerate（加速）、spike（急遽上升）都與「需求隨氣溫回升而逐漸減緩」不符。雅思寫作 Task 1 常用 ease off 描述某項數據力道逐漸減弱。

stem: Analysts noted a small ____ in consumer confidence last month, the first positive sign after nearly a year of steady decline.
explain_zh: uptick 表示「（數值）小幅上升」；downturn（下滑）、collapse（崩跌）、slump（暴跌）都與「消費者信心出現小幅正向訊號」矛盾。雅思寫作 Task 1 常用 a small uptick in 描述數據出現小幅正向變化。

stem: The wage gap between the two industries has begun to ____ slightly, largely thanks to new minimum wage legislation introduced last year.
explain_zh: narrow（此處作動詞）表示（差距）「縮小」；widen（擴大）、expand（擴張）、grow（增長）都與「因最低薪資立法使薪資差距縮小」相反。雅思寫作 Task 1 常用 the gap narrowed/widened 描述兩組數據差距的變化。

stem: Sales of electric vehicles are expected to ____ those of petrol cars within the next decade, according to several industry forecasts.
explain_zh: surpass 表示「超越、超過」；resemble（相似）、trail（落後）、match（相符）都無法表達「電動車銷量預計將超越燃油車」的意思。雅思寫作 Task 1 常用 surpass 描述某項數據超越另一項。

stem: Within just five years, online retail sales had completely ____ sales made through traditional catalogue mail order in this particular market.
explain_zh: eclipse 表示「（成長迅速而）大幅超越、使相形失色」；resemble（相似）、follow（跟隨）、join（加入）都無法表達「線上零售銷量迅速超越傳統型錄郵購」的意思。雅思寫作 Task 1 高分句常用 eclipse 描述某項數據迅速壓倒另一項。

stem: Share prices ____ by almost forty percent within a single trading session after the company unexpectedly announced disappointing quarterly results.
explain_zh: plunge 表示「（數值）暴跌」；climb（攀升）、stabilise（穩定下來）、plateau（持平）都與「單日內暴跌近四成」矛盾。雅思寫作 Task 1 常用 plunge 描述數據急遽且大幅下跌。

stem: Consumer spending took a ____ during the final quarter, as rising energy bills left households with far less disposable income.
explain_zh: nosedive 表示「（數值）急遽下滑」（take a nosedive 是固定用法）；rise（上升）、leap（躍升）、boost（提振）語意都與「消費支出因能源帳單上升而大幅減少」相反。雅思寫作 Task 1 常用 take a nosedive 描述數據急速下滑。

stem: Property prices in the capital ____ after the government announced a major new transport link connecting the area to the city centre.
explain_zh: rocket 表示「（數值）飆升、急遽上升」；stabilised（穩定下來）、dropped（下降）、flattened（趨於平緩）都與「因新交通建設宣布而房價飆升」矛盾。雅思寫作 Task 1 常用 rocket 描述數據急遽飆升。

stem: Demand for home office furniture began to ____ as soon as companies announced that remote working would continue permanently.
explain_zh: skyrocket 表示「急遽飆升」（比 rocket 語氣更強烈）；decline（下降）、stabilise（穩定下來）、ease（緩和）都與「居家辦公家具需求因遠距工作政策而急遽攀升」矛盾。雅思寫作 Task 1 常用 skyrocket 描述數據瞬間暴增。

stem: Average class sizes have begun to ____ slightly in recent years as school budgets fail to keep pace with rising student numbers.
explain_zh: inch up 表示「緩慢地小幅上升」；collapse（崩潰）、plummet（暴跌）、freeze（凍結不變）都與「班級人數逐漸小幅增加」不符。雅思寫作 Task 1 常用 inch up 描述數據極為緩慢地小幅上升。

stem: Household debt levels have begun to ____ again, worrying economists who fear a repeat of the financial problems seen a decade ago.
explain_zh: creep up 表示「（數值）不知不覺、緩慢地上升」；disappear（消失）、collapse（崩潰）、stabilise（穩定下來）都與「家庭債務悄悄回升，令經濟學家擔憂」不符。雅思寫作 Task 1 常用 creep up 描述數據緩慢而不易察覺地上升。

stem: Critics argued that the survey sample was ____ , since it included far more young respondents than any other age group.
explain_zh: skewed 表示（樣本或數據）「失衡、有偏差的」；random（隨機的）、representative（有代表性的）、balanced（平衡的）都與「樣本嚴重偏向某個年齡層」矛盾。雅思閱讀研究方法文章常用 skewed sample 描述取樣不具代表性的問題。

stem: The link between the two events was extremely ____ , resting on nothing more than a vague coincidence in timing.
explain_zh: tenuous 表示「薄弱的、缺乏根據的」（連結或論點站不住腳）；obvious（明顯的）、proven（已證明的）、strong（強而有力的）都與「僅憑巧合、缺乏根據的薄弱關聯」矛盾。雅思閱讀常用 a tenuous link/connection 描述缺乏堅實證據支持的關聯。

stem: The committee praised the study for its ____ methodology, noting that the large sample size made the results highly reliable.
explain_zh: robust 表示（研究方法）「嚴謹可靠的」；flawed（有缺陷的）、weak（薄弱的）、questionable（可疑的）都與「委員會稱讚其方法嚴謹，結果可靠」矛盾。雅思閱讀學術方法論文章常用 robust methodology 稱讚研究設計嚴謹。

stem: Despite months of preparation, the lawyer admitted that the case against the defendant was far from ____ , since several key pieces of evidence remained open to interpretation.
explain_zh: watertight 表示（論證或案件）「無懈可擊的」；flawed（有缺陷的）、weak（薄弱的）、doubtful（可疑的）語意都與「無懈可擊」相反，且句意「證據仍有解讀空間」暗示案件並不牢靠。雅思閱讀法律與論證文章常用 a watertight case/argument 描述滴水不漏的論證。

stem: Some companies exploit a legal ____ to avoid paying tax on profits earned overseas, a practice that governments are now trying to close.
explain_zh: loophole 表示「（法律或規則的）漏洞」；regulation（規範）、penalty（罰則）、obligation（義務）都與「利用法律漏洞避稅」的情境不符。雅思寫作 Task 2 常用 exploit a loophole 描述鑽法律漏洞的行為。

stem: The report recommends expanding the trial programme, with one important ____ : funding must first be secured for long-term monitoring.
explain_zh: caveat 表示「但書、附帶條件」（提出建議時附加的警語或限制）；summary（摘要）、apology（道歉）、headline（標題）都無法表達「提出建議但附加一項重要但書」。雅思寫作 Task 2 高分文章常用 with one important caveat 提出附帶條件的論述。

stem: Although most board members supported the merger, the finance director expressed serious ____ about the company's ability to repay the resulting debt.
explain_zh: reservation 表示「保留意見、疑慮」；enthusiasm（熱忱）、agreement（同意）、confidence（信心）都與「對償債能力表示嚴重疑慮」矛盾。雅思寫作 Task 2 常用 express reservations about 表達對某項提案的保留態度。

stem: New investors are often warned about the common ____ of putting all their savings into a single company's shares.
explain_zh: pitfall 表示「陷阱、潛在的風險或錯誤」；benefit（好處）、advantage（優點）、opportunity（機會）語意都相反或不符。雅思寫作 Task 2 常用 a common pitfall 描述人們容易犯的錯誤或陷入的陷阱。

stem: Few politicians fully considered the long-term ____ of the policy, focusing instead on its short-term popularity with voters.
explain_zh: ramification 表示「（政策等的）後續影響、牽連結果」；headlines（頭條新聞）、statistics（統計數據）、publicity（宣傳）都與「政策帶來的長期後續影響」不符。雅思寫作 Task 2 常用 long-term ramifications 描述政策深遠的連鎖影響。

stem: Failing to meet the delivery deadline could have serious ____ for the company's reputation among its largest clients.
explain_zh: repercussion 表示（負面）「後果、衝擊」；benefits（好處）、discounts（折扣）、rewards（獎勵）語意都相反或不符。雅思寫作 Task 2 常用 serious repercussions 描述某項失誤帶來的嚴重負面後果。

stem: The company faced a fierce ____ on social media after customers discovered that its 'eco-friendly' packaging was not recyclable at all.
explain_zh: backlash 表示「強烈的負面反彈、群起反對」；praise（讚美）、welcome（歡迎）、endorsement（背書）語意都與「消費者發現廣告不實後群起抵制」相反。雅思閱讀企業公關議題文章常用 face a backlash 描述遭受強烈反彈。

stem: Human rights groups moved quickly to ____ the new law, arguing that it unfairly targeted vulnerable minority communities.
explain_zh: denounce 表示「公開譴責、強烈批評」；welcome（歡迎）、endorse（背書）、praise（讚美）語意都相反。雅思閱讀人權與政策議題文章常用 denounce 描述團體公開譴責某項政策。

stem: World leaders from across the region were quick to ____ the attack, calling it an unacceptable violation of international law.
explain_zh: condemn 表示「譴責」；welcome（歡迎）、ignore（忽略）、downplay（淡化）語意都與「各國領袖迅速譴責攻擊事件」不符。雅思閱讀國際新聞文章常用 condemn 描述官方對事件的強烈譴責。

stem: Throughout her career, the scientist has ____ the use of renewable energy, testifying before parliament on numerous occasions.
explain_zh: champion（此處作動詞）表示「大力提倡、支持」；opposed（反對）語意相反，ignored（忽略）、denied（否認）也與「積極倡導再生能源、多次向國會作證」不符。雅思閱讀人物傳記類文章常用 champion 描述某人大力提倡某項理念。

stem: One clear ____ of the new policy is that it will significantly reduce paperwork for small business owners applying for licences.
explain_zh: upside 表示「好處、正面的一面」；drawback（缺點）、concern（疑慮）、risk（風險）語意都相反或不符。雅思寫作 Task 2 常用 one upside of 引出某項政策的正面效益，常與 downside 成對出現。

stem: Years after the scandal, newly released documents finally ____ the whistleblower, proving that her original allegations had been entirely accurate.
explain_zh: vindicate 表示「證明（某人的說法或立場）是正確的、還其清白」；discredit（使名譽受損）語意相反，punish（懲罰）、silence（使沉默）也與「文件證明她原本的指控完全正確」矛盾。雅思閱讀正義與媒體議題文章常用 vindicate 描述某人最終被證明是對的。

stem: Public health officials declared an ____ after the number of confirmed cases tripled within just two weeks across the region.
explain_zh: epidemic 表示「（疾病）流行病、疫情」；recession（經濟衰退）、shortage（短缺）、surplus（過剩）都與「確診病例快速增加」的公共衛生情境不符。雅思閱讀健康議題文章常用 declare an epidemic 描述官方宣布疫情爆發。

stem: Employers are increasingly investing in staff ____ programmes, offering counselling services and flexible hours to reduce workplace stress.
explain_zh: well-being 表示「身心健康、福祉」；production（生產）、recruitment（招募）、discipline（紀律）都與「提供諮商服務與彈性工時以減少職場壓力」的目的不符。雅思口說與寫作健康話題常用 well-being 描述整體身心健康狀態。

stem: Investing in ____ , such as regular health check-ups and vaccinations, is often far cheaper than treating serious illness later on.
explain_zh: preventive care 表示「預防性醫療照護」（透過定期檢查與疫苗預防疾病）；emergency surgery（急診手術）、cosmetic surgery（整形手術）、intensive care（加護照護）都與「定期健康檢查與疫苗接種」這類預防性措施不同。雅思閱讀健康政策文章常用 preventive care 描述以預防為主的醫療投資。

stem: An ageing population puts increasing pressure on the country's ____ , as more elderly patients require long-term treatment and care.
explain_zh: healthcare system 表示「醫療體系」；transport network（交通網路）、education system（教育體系）、legal system（法律體系）都與「高齡人口需要長期醫療照護」的壓力來源不符。雅思寫作 Task 2 常討論高齡化對 healthcare system 造成的負擔。

stem: ____ in the city's public hospitals has led to longer waiting times, with some patients waiting several hours just to see a doctor.
explain_zh: overcrowding 表示「過度擁擠」（空間或設施容納超過負荷）；renovation（翻修）、investment（投資）、automation（自動化）都與「醫院人滿為患導致等待時間變長」的因果關係不符。雅思閱讀都市議題文章常用 overcrowding 描述設施或空間過度擁擠的問題。

stem: As wealthier residents moved into the once run-down neighbourhood, rising rents caused by ____ forced many long-term families to relocate elsewhere.
explain_zh: gentrification 表示（原本較貧困的社區因富裕居民遷入而）「仕紳化、房價房租上漲」；deforestation（森林砍伐）、immigration（移民）、industrialisation（工業化）都與「富裕居民遷入導致原居民因租金上漲被迫搬離」的都市現象不符。雅思閱讀都市發展文章常用 gentrification 描述社區仕紳化的過程。

stem: Unchecked ____ has swallowed up farmland on the edge of the city, forcing residents to commute much further to reach the centre.
explain_zh: urban sprawl 表示「都市無序擴張」（城市向外蔓延吞噬周邊土地）；deforestation（森林砍伐）、migration（遷徙）、congestion（壅塞）都無法精準表達「城市邊緣不斷向外擴張吞噬農地」的現象。雅思閱讀都市規劃文章常用 urban sprawl 描述城市無序擴張的問題。

stem: To accommodate the growing population without expanding further into the countryside, planners approved several new ____ apartment blocks near the station.
explain_zh: high-rise 表示「高樓層的、高層建築」；detached（獨棟的）、single-storey（單層的）、suburban（郊區的）都與「為容納人口成長而興建高樓公寓」的作法不符。雅思閱讀都市規劃文章常用 high-rise apartments 描述因應人口成長而興建的高層住宅。

stem: Rather than holding a single permanent job, many young workers now piece together an income through the ____ , taking on short-term freelance tasks.
explain_zh: gig economy 表示「零工經濟」（依靠短期、彈性的接案工作維生的經濟模式）；black market（黑市）、stock market（股市）、welfare state（福利國家）都與「靠短期接案工作拼湊收入」的模式不符。雅思口說工作話題常討論 gig economy 對傳統就業型態的衝擊。

stem: ____ has become far more common since the pandemic, with many employees now working from home several days a week instead of commuting to an office.
explain_zh: telecommuting 表示「遠距通勤、在家上班」；manufacturing（製造業）、recruitment（招募）、outsourcing（外包）都與「員工改在家工作而非通勤到辦公室」的具體現象不符。雅思口說工作話題常用 telecommuting 描述遠距工作的趨勢。

stem: To cut costs, the company began ____ its customer service operations to a firm based overseas, which caused concern among local employees about job security.
explain_zh: outsourcing 表示「外包」（將部分業務委託給外部或海外公司）；expanding（擴張）、funding（資助）、restructuring（重組，語意較廣）都不如 outsourcing 精準表達「將業務委託給海外公司」的具體做法。雅思寫作 Task 2 常用 outsourcing jobs overseas 討論全球化對本地就業的影響。

stem: Programmes that offer job training to former prisoners have been shown to significantly reduce ____ , helping former offenders avoid returning to crime.
explain_zh: recidivism 表示「再犯率」（出獄後再度犯罪的比例）；literacy（識字率）、poverty（貧窮）、inflation（通膨）都與「協助更生人避免再度犯罪」無關。雅思閱讀犯罪與司法改革文章常用 reduce recidivism 描述降低再犯率的措施。

stem: Supporters argue that harsher sentences act as a strong ____ , discouraging potential offenders from committing similar crimes in the first place.
explain_zh: deterrent 表示「威懾、遏阻因素」；incentive（誘因）、reward（獎勵）語意相反，excuse（藉口）也不符合「嚴厲刑罰嚇阻潛在犯罪者」的意思。雅思寫作 Task 2 犯罪議題常用 act as a deterrent 討論刑罰是否具有嚇阻效果。

stem: Local residents complained about repeated acts of ____ in the park, including broken benches and walls covered in spray paint.
explain_zh: vandalism 表示「蓄意破壞公物」；charity（慈善）、volunteering（志願服務）、maintenance（維護）都與「破壞長椅、噴漆塗鴉」的行為不符。雅思閱讀社區治安議題文章常用 vandalism 描述蓄意破壞公共財物的行為。

stem: Researchers found a strong link between family instability and ____ , suggesting that early intervention programmes could help prevent young people from turning to crime.
explain_zh: juvenile delinquency 表示「青少年犯罪」；unemployment（失業）、illiteracy（文盲）、homelessness（無家可歸）都與「與家庭不穩定有關、及早介入可預防青少年犯罪」的具體主題不符。雅思閱讀社會議題文章常用 juvenile delinquency 描述青少年犯罪問題。

stem: Critics argue that strict government ____ of the internet prevents citizens from accessing independent news sources and forming their own opinions.
explain_zh: censorship 表示（政府對言論或媒體的）「審查」；investment（投資）、regulation（規範，語意較中性）、taxation（課稅）都無法精準表達「阻止民眾取得獨立新聞來源」這種限制言論自由的行為。雅思閱讀媒體議題文章常用 censorship 描述政府限制資訊流通的行為。

stem: During the conflict, both sides used ____ to shape public opinion, often exaggerating their own successes while downplaying their losses.
explain_zh: propaganda 表示（帶有政治目的、常含誇大或扭曲的）「宣傳」；journalism（新聞業，通常較中立）、diplomacy（外交）、translation（翻譯）都與「誇大己方成就、淡化己方損失以操縱輿論」的行為不符。雅思閱讀媒體與戰爭議題文章常用 propaganda 描述帶有操縱目的的宣傳手法。

stem: Applicants are only ____ for the government grant if their household income falls below a certain threshold set each year.
explain_zh: eligible (for) 表示「符合資格的」；illegible 指「（字跡）難以辨認的」，negligible 指「可忽略不計的」，legible 指「（字跡）清晰易讀的」，拼字都與 eligible 相近但意義完全不同。雅思閱讀獎學金／申請資格類文章常考 eligible 與 illegible 這組易混淆字。

stem: Employees may claim additional tax relief for each ____ , such as a child or an elderly parent, who relies on them financially.
explain_zh: dependant（名詞）指「受扶養者」，用來指經濟上依賴某人的家屬（如子女或年邁父母）；dependence 是抽象名詞「依賴（狀態）」，dependently 詞性不對，dependable 指「可靠的」，語意都不符合「可申請扶養親屬抵稅」的情境。雅思閱讀稅務與福利文章常考 dependant（人）與 dependent（形容詞「依賴的」）這組拼字相近但詞性不同的字。

stem: Although the architect's design was visually striking, engineers questioned whether it was actually ____ given the site's unstable ground conditions.
explain_zh: practicable 表示「（在特定條件下）行得通的、可實行的」，強調客觀條件是否允許執行；practical 通常指「實用的、務實的」（較廣泛的特質），practicing 是動詞的現在分詞，practised 指「熟練的」，語意或詞性都不如 practicable 精確對應「考量地質條件是否可行」。雅思閱讀工程與可行性研究文章常考 practicable 與 practical 這組易混淆字。

stem: The poet's vivid descriptions of taste, scent and texture create a deeply ____ reading experience that appeals directly to the senses.
explain_zh: sensuous 表示「訴諸感官享受的」，用來形容充滿感官描寫的文學作品最恰當；sensible（明智的）、sensitive（敏感的）、senseless（無意義的）語意都不符合「訴諸味覺、嗅覺與觸覺的閱讀體驗」。雅思閱讀文學評論類文章偶爾會考 sensuous 這個較少見但易混淆的字。

stem: Negotiating the merger involved a ____ process of legal reviews and revisions that dragged on for nearly two years.
explain_zh: tortuous 表示「（過程）曲折冗長、複雜迂迴的」，用來形容耗時近兩年的談判過程最恰當；straightforward（直接了當的）、brief（簡短的）、simple（簡單的）都與「曲折冗長的流程」矛盾。雅思閱讀商業談判文章常考 tortuous 與 torturous（痛苦的，拼字相近但意義不同）這組易混淆字。

stem: Nutritionists recommend that people gradually replace sugary snacks with more ____ alternatives, such as fresh fruit or unsalted nuts.
explain_zh: healthful 表示「有益健康的、促進健康的」，用來形容食物選擇最恰當；wealthy（富有的）、stealthy（隱秘的）語意完全不同，healthfully 則是副詞，詞性不符合修飾名詞 alternatives 的需求。雅思閱讀健康飲食文章偶爾會考 healthful 這個描述食物有益健康的正式用字。

stem: The new recycling bins were placed ____ the main entrance so that visitors would see them as soon as they arrived.
explain_zh: beside（介系詞）表示「在…旁邊」，用來描述回收桶的實際擺放位置；besides 表示「除了…之外；此外」，是完全不同的意思；moreover、furthermore 都是「此外」的連接副詞，皆不符合描述具體位置的需求。雅思閱讀常考 beside 與 besides 這組拼字相近但意義不同的字。

stem: Of the two hiking trails, the mountain route extends ____ into the wilderness and takes almost twice as long to complete.
explain_zh: farther 傳統上多用於描述「實際的物理距離」，符合「山路延伸進入荒野的距離」；further 較常用於抽象意義（如「進一步的」），farthest、furthest 則是最高級，與句中比較兩條路線（用比較級即可）的語意不符。雅思閱讀常考 farther 與 further 這組意義相近但傳統用法略有區別的字。

stem: Homeowners are strongly advised to ____ their property against flood damage, especially if they live near a river or coastline.
explain_zh: insure (against) 表示「投保、為…保險」；ensure 表示「確保」，assure 表示「向某人保證」，reassure 表示「使安心」，三者拼字相近但意義都與「為財產投保」不同。雅思閱讀保險與財務規劃文章常考 insure、ensure、assure 這組易混淆字。

stem: The manager tried to ____ worried staff that no jobs would be lost during the company's restructuring process.
explain_zh: assure (someone) 表示「向某人保證、使安心」，直接接人作受詞；ensure 表示「確保（某事發生）」，通常不直接接人；insure 指「投保」，secure 指「使安全、取得」，語意都不符合「向員工保證不會裁員」。雅思閱讀常考 assure、ensure、insure 這組拼字相近但用法不同的字。

stem: The report presents the survey findings in ____ form, with tables and percentages rather than lengthy written descriptions.
explain_zh: numerical 表示「數字的、以數字呈現的」，用來形容以表格與百分比呈現的資料最恰當；numerous 表示「許多的」，numerable 指「可數的」，numeral 是名詞「數字符號」，語意或詞性都不符合「以數字形式呈現資料」的意思。雅思閱讀統計報告文章常考 numerical 與 numerous 這組拼字相近但意義不同的字。

stem: Many first-time buyers need to ____ a substantial amount of money from a bank in order to afford a property in the city.
explain_zh: borrow (from) 表示「向…借（錢）」；lend 表示「借出（錢）給別人」，方向相反；loan 通常作名詞，作動詞時語氣較正式且常見於機構借出；owe 表示「欠（錢）」，語意也不同。雅思閱讀財務議題文章常考 borrow 與 lend 這組方向相反的易混淆字。

stem: The orchestra performed a programme of ____ music from the eighteenth century, featuring works by Mozart and Haydn.
explain_zh: classical 表示「古典（時期）的」，用來形容十八世紀的古典樂派音樂最恰當；classic 表示「經典的、典型的」（泛指任何領域中最具代表性的作品，不限於古典樂派），classified 指「機密的」，classy 指「時髦優雅的」，語意都不如 classical 精確對應「古典時期音樂」。雅思閱讀藝術與音樂文章常考 classic 與 classical 這組拼字相近但意義不同的字。

stem: The final two hours of the marathon felt utterly ____ , as the runner's legs cramped painfully with every remaining step.
explain_zh: torturous 表示「（身體或精神上）極其痛苦的、折磨人的」，用來形容雙腿抽筋的痛苦最恰當；tortuous 指「（路徑或過程）曲折複雜的」，拼字相近但意義不同；straightforward（直接了當的）、comfortable（舒適的）也與「極度痛苦」相反。雅思閱讀運動與健康文章常考 torturous 與 tortuous 這組拼字相近但意義不同的字。

stem: Small island nations that rely heavily on tourism are especially ____ on a small number of wealthy visiting countries for their economic survival.
explain_zh: dependent (on) 是形容詞「依賴的」，符合 be especially ____ on 的文法結構；dependant 是名詞「受扶養者（人）」，dependable 指「可靠的」，dependence 是名詞「依賴（狀態）」，詞性或語意都不符合這個句子結構。雅思閱讀常考 dependant（受扶養者）與 dependent（依賴的）這組發音相同但詞性不同的字。

stem: ____ offering free delivery, the company also provides a full refund to any customer who is not completely satisfied with their purchase.
explain_zh: besides 表示「除了…之外」，後面可接動名詞片語，符合句首「除了提供免運費之外」的語意；beside 表示「在…旁邊」，意義完全不同；moreover（此外，通常接完整句子而非動名詞片語）、however（然而）語意連接邏輯也不符合這個句子結構。雅思閱讀常考 besides 與 beside 這組拼字相近但意義不同的字。

stem: Rising interest rates can act as a powerful ____ for saving, encouraging households to put more money into their bank accounts.
explain_zh: stimulus 表示「刺激因素、誘因」，act as a stimulus for 是固定用法；stimulant 通常指「（藥物或飲料等）興奮劑」，語意不同；simulation 指「模擬」，stimulate 是動詞，詞性或語意都不符合這個名詞用法。雅思閱讀經濟類文章常用 act as a stimulus for 描述促進某行為的誘因。

stem: Before drawing any conclusions, the researchers ran a ____ test to check whether the difference between the two groups was significant.
explain_zh: 空格後接名詞 test，前面需要形容詞修飾，故選 statistical（統計學上的）；statistics 是名詞，statistician 是名詞（統計學家），statistically 是副詞，詞性都不符合「形容詞加名詞」的結構。雅思閱讀研究方法文章常用 statistical test/significance 這類詞組。

stem: Some economists argue that it is ____ to keep interest rates low while inflation continues to rise rapidly.
explain_zh: 空格在 it is 之後，需要形容詞作補語，故選 illogical（不合邏輯的）；logic 是名詞，logically 是副詞，logician 是名詞（邏輯學家），詞性都不符合「be 動詞加形容詞」的結構。雅思寫作 Task 2 常用 illogical 批評某項政策缺乏邏輯。

stem: The two proposals look quite different on paper, but ____ speaking, they would produce almost identical results for most households.
explain_zh: 空格修飾 speaking，形成 practically speaking（實際上來說）這個固定副詞片語，故選 practically；practice 是名詞（英式拼法），practical 是形容詞，practise 是動詞（英式拼法），詞性都不符合這個固定用法。雅思口說常用 practically speaking 這個口語化的過渡語。

stem: Each product now carries a clearly ____ barcode, allowing staff to track its location throughout the entire supply chain.
explain_zh: 空格後接名詞 barcode，前面有副詞 clearly 修飾，需要形容詞，故選 identifiable（可識別的）；identify 是動詞，identity 是名詞（身分），identification 是名詞（識別；身分證明），詞性都不符合「形容詞加名詞」的結構。雅思閱讀物流與科技文章常考此類詞性變化。

stem: Regular ____ of the water pipes could have prevented the burst that flooded three floors of the building last winter.
explain_zh: 空格前有形容詞 regular 修飾，且需要名詞作為句子主詞，故選 maintenance（維護保養）；maintain 是動詞，maintainable 是形容詞，maintained 是過去式或過去分詞，詞性都不符合句子結構所需的名詞。雅思閱讀基礎建設議題文章常用 regular maintenance 描述定期保養的重要性。

stem: The proposal received strong ____ support, with several government ministries agreeing to jointly fund the new pilot programme this year.
explain_zh: 空格後接名詞 support，前面需要形容詞修飾，故選 governmental（政府的）；govern 是動詞，government 是名詞（也可作形容詞用但較常見於複合名詞），governance 是名詞（治理），此處最精確的形容詞形式是 governmental。雅思閱讀政策類文章常用 governmental support/agencies 這類詞組。

stem: Before accepting the job offer, she researched the ____ thoroughly, reading reviews from current and former staff members online.
explain_zh: 空格前有 researched the，需要指「雇主（機構或公司）」的名詞，故選 employer（雇主）；employment 是「就業、雇用（抽象概念）」而非指雇主本身，employ 是動詞，employed 是形容詞或過去分詞，詞性或語意都不符合「查詢雇主的員工評價」。雅思閱讀求職議題文章常考人稱名詞的用法。

stem: Children who grow up speaking two languages at home often process certain cognitive tasks ____ from those who are raised monolingually.
explain_zh: 空格修飾動詞 process，需要副詞，故選 differently（以不同方式）；different 是形容詞，difference 是名詞，differ 是動詞，詞性都不符合「副詞修飾動詞」的結構。雅思閱讀語言學習文章常用 process…differently 描述雙語者認知處理方式的差異。

stem: As an experienced ____ , she was regularly invited to advise the ministry on how to reform the national curriculum.
explain_zh: 空格前有形容詞 experienced 修飾，且需要指「人」的名詞，故選 educator（教育工作者）；education 是抽象名詞（教育），educate 是動詞，educational 是形容詞，詞性或語意都不符合「她是一位經驗豐富的教育工作者」。雅思閱讀教育政策文章常考人稱名詞的用法。

stem: Supporters of financial ____ argue that removing certain rules allows banks to lend more freely and stimulate economic growth.
explain_zh: 空格前有形容詞 financial 修飾，且需要名詞作為 supporters of 的受詞，故選 deregulation（解除管制）；regulate 是動詞，regulator 是名詞（監管者），regulatory 是形容詞，詞性或語意都不符合「支持解除金融管制的人」。雅思閱讀經濟政策文章常用 financial deregulation 這類詞組。

stem: Critics argue that modern ____ encourages people to define their identity through what they own rather than who they are.
explain_zh: 空格前有形容詞 modern 修飾，且需要抽象名詞作為句子主詞，故選 consumerism（消費主義）；consumer 是名詞（消費者，指人而非概念），consumption 是名詞（消費行為本身），consume 是動詞，語意或詞性都不如 consumerism 精確對應「一種鼓勵以物質定義身分的社會現象」。雅思寫作 Task 2 常用 consumerism 批評物質主義文化。

stem: Universities are under growing pressure to design courses that directly improve graduates' ____ in an increasingly competitive job market.
explain_zh: 空格前有 improve graduates'，需要名詞作受詞，故選 employability（就業能力）；employed 是形容詞或過去分詞，employer 指「雇主」，employment 指「就業（狀態）」，語意都不如 employability 精確對應「畢業生被雇用的能力或競爭力」。雅思寫作 Task 2 常用 employability 討論大學教育與職場需求的連結。

stem: When funding is limited, small charities often have to think ____ about how to reach as many people as possible.
explain_zh: 空格修飾動詞 think，需要副詞，故選 creatively（有創意地）；creative 是形容詞，creation 是名詞，creator 是名詞（創造者），詞性都不符合「副詞修飾動詞」的結構。雅思口說與寫作常用 think creatively 描述在資源有限下發揮創意。

stem: To attract skilled workers, the company decided to price its salaries ____ compared with similar firms in the same industry.
explain_zh: 空格修飾動詞 price，需要副詞，故選 competitively（有競爭力地）；competitor 是名詞（競爭對手），competitive 是形容詞，competition 是名詞，詞性都不符合「副詞修飾動詞」的結構。雅思寫作 Task 2 商業主題常用 price competitively 這類詞組。

stem: Rather than paying out large dividends, the company chose to ____ most of its profits back into research and development.
explain_zh: 空格前有 to（不定詞），後面需要動詞原形，故選 reinvest（再投資）；investment 是名詞，investor 是名詞（投資者），investing 是動名詞，詞性都不符合「to 加原形動詞」的結構。雅思閱讀企業財務文章常用 reinvest profits 描述將獲利再投入公司發展。

stem: Employees who take short breaks throughout the day are often able to use their remaining working hours far more ____ .
explain_zh: 空格在 far more 之後，修飾動詞 use，需要副詞，故選 productively（有效率地）；production 是名詞，productive 是形容詞，produce 是動詞或名詞，詞性都不符合「副詞修飾動詞」的結構。雅思口說與寫作常討論如何更 productively 運用時間。

stem: Visitors to the exhibition were asked to indicate their ____ on the entry form, along with their age group and reason for visiting.
explain_zh: 空格前有 indicate their，需要名詞作受詞，故選 nationality（國籍）；national 是形容詞，nationally 是副詞，nationalise 是動詞「使國有化」，詞性都不符合「填寫國籍欄位」的語境。雅思聽力填空題常考 nationality 這個表格常見欄位詞彙。

stem: Some scientists worry that the rapid ____ of gene-editing technology is moving faster than the ethical debate about its proper use.
explain_zh: 空格前有形容詞 rapid 修飾，且介系詞 of 前面需要名詞，故選 commercialisation（商業化）；commercial 是形容詞，commercially 是副詞，commercialise 是動詞，詞性都不符合句子結構所需的名詞。雅思閱讀科技倫理文章常用 the commercialisation of 描述新科技被商業化的速度。
